notes:
Inbound self-serve signup (product modal) -> flagged by lead scoring (high dev activity). Small B2B SaaS making in-app chat assistant embedded in their product UI (React frontend + serverless backend on AWS us-east-1). Priority is streaming typing latency + predictable tail latency; team wants sub-150ms 95th for short-turn interactions.

Key ask: hosted API for fast time-to-market. Wants token streaming (SSE or WebSocket) + function-calling for tool hooks. Prefers smaller low-latency quantized models for cost reasons but open to Redwood-curated variants. Mentioned: "we need the assistant to feel instant — anything over quarter-second feels laggy to users."

Security: SOC2 roadmap is in progress (expected Q1), will require SSO for admin console and audit logs. Data residency not firm requirement now but may become so for enterprise customers.

Commercial: early-stage ARR, cost sensitive — wants guidance on batching/quantization to hit target latency and keep cost under control. Interested in trial credits and a simple hosted plan to start.

Integration notes: frontend dev had CORS/ws questions; serverless infra team wants clear token limits and retry/fallback guidance. Product team ran a small smoke test during demo: median token latency ~120-180ms depending on model; 95th at ~280ms. Need assistance to tune to <150ms 95th for the prioritized flows.

Quotes/phrases captured: "Can we stream tokens directly into our chat UI without a lambda cold start causing the spike?" — Lead frontend dev. "We don't want to manage GPUs yet — hosted first, move to dedicated if we get enterprise deals." — CEO.

Stubs: security questionnaire sent (drive link), demo recording on Fireflies, short performance log attached to RDW-1287.
